scripts.test: npm run verify:phase3 && node scripts/run-tool.mjs vitest run src/ --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1
scripts.build:domain:offline: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.offline-build', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.domain.json
scripts.verify:phase1: npm run typecheck:domain && npm run test:domain:offline && npm run verify:architecture
scripts.build:phase2-logic:offline: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.phase2-build', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.phase2-logic.json
scripts.verify:phase2: npm run verify:phase1 && npm run test:phase2:offline && npm run verify:phase2:structure
scripts.verify:phase3: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:phase2 && node tests/phase3.test.mjs
